system.description:
You begin to enhance the defensive potential of jutsu you cast for the duration.

You begin to radiate chakra forming defensive layers of chakra gaining the following benefits.

The number of Royal Shield charges you gain from jutsu that grant them, increases by +2.

Taijutsu, you cast that increases your AC, increases that bonus by +1.

Taijutsu you cast that grant you Temporary hit points, increase the temporary hit points gained by +1 dice.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, this jutsu gains the Efficient keyword. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, reduce the cost of Royal Guard by half.
